# Ebook

> Ebook is a small online store selling PDF ebooks: four guides on AI tools, money habits, gut health and sleep routines, and a three-book psychological thriller series, The Lying Trilogy. Each ebook is $5.99; the four guides are $15.99 together and the three fiction books are $13.99 together.

## Ebooks
- [AI Money Machine](https://aiebook.site/ai-money-machine.html): A practical guide to exploring AI-assisted services, digital tools and your first client-ready workflow.
- [Gut Reset](https://aiebook.site/gut-reset.html): A 30-day educational guide to the gut microbiome, food choices and everyday wellbeing habits.
- [The Gen Z Wealth Code](https://aiebook.site/gen-z-wealth-code.html): An introduction to money habits, digital skills and ways to think about building long-term financial capability.
- [Sleep Like a CEO](https://aiebook.site/sleep-like-a-ceo.html): An educational guide to sleep routines, common disruptors and building a more consistent wind-down.

## Fiction: The Lying Trilogy
- [My Husband Is Lying](https://aiebook.site/my-husband-is-lying.html): Book 1 of The Lying Trilogy. He proposed in the rain. He lied in the dark.
- [My Wife Is Lying](https://aiebook.site/my-wife-is-lying.html): Book 2 of The Lying Trilogy. She picked up the knife. She lied to the police. And Jake is about to find out.
- [We Were Both Lying](https://aiebook.site/we-were-both-lying.html): Book 3 of The Lying Trilogy, the final book. Chloe is back. And this time, she is not alone.
